about: MusicBrainz (open music encyclopedia): browse genres, instruments, artists, release groups, statistics and relationship types from the public musicbrainz.org web pages and their JSON helper endpoints.

commands.summary: List all genres in MusicBrainz, with each genre's name and detail URL (the MBID is in the URL)
Get one genre: name, primary tag, relationships (parent genres, subgenres, fusions/influences) and its Wikipedia summary
Get the cached Wikipedia summary (HTML) for a genre, instrument, artist or release group; wikipediaExtract is null when none is linked
List all instruments, each with its name, short description and detail URL (the MBID is in the URL)
Get one instrument: name, type, description, relationships (subtypes, parent type, related instruments) and Wikidata link
List artists credited with playing an instrument, with artist type, gender, area and credit (paginated)
List releases featuring an instrument, with artist, format, tracks, country, date, label and catalog number (paginated)
List recordings featuring an instrument, with artist and length (paginated)
List the user-applied tags (with vote counts and any linked genre) on an instrument, artist or release group
Get an artist's details: name, type, country, begin/end dates, area, genres and external links (relations: Discogs, Wikidata, etc.)
Get a release group (album/single): title, artist credit, type, first release date, genres, external links and its list of release versions
List every release version of a release group, with date, country, status, barcode, labels/catalog numbers and media formats
Get the database statistics overview: counts of artists, releases, recordings, labels, works, disc IDs, editors, etc.
Get per-country counts of artists, releases, labels, events and places, ranked
Get the historical time series for one statistic as a map of date -> value (e.g. artist or release count over time)

params.name: stat
params.description: Statistic key, e.g. count.artist, count.release, count.recording, count.label, count.work, count.releasegroup

commands.summary: List MusicBrainz project milestones (date, title, description, blog link) shown on the statistics timeline
List the entity-type pairs that have relationship types (e.g. Artist-Instrument), each with a link to its relationship types
List the relationship types between two entity types (e.g. artist-instrument), with link phrases, description and documentation link

params.name: pair
params.description: Entity-type pair, lowercase and joined by '-', in the order used on /relationships, e.g. artist-instrument, artist-release_group, area-area
